newsitem.title: USA: Hi-Shear Technology says Q2 orders rise.
newsitem.headline: Hi-Shear Technology says Q2 orders rise.

text.p: Hi-Shear Technology Corp said on Friday its new orders for the fiscal second quarter, ended November 30, totaled $5.82 milllion, a 157 percent increase from the year ago quarter's $2.26 million.
In the first half of its current fiscal year, Hi-Shear received new orders of $9.59 million as compared to $6.28 million in last year's first half, or a 53% increase.
In a statement, the company said its target is to win over $15 to $17 million in new orders for the fiscal year.
